calendar.title: Calendar feed
calendar.intro: Your sessions, the events you are going to and your drive deadlines, in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or any calendar that subscribes to a link. It updates by itself.
calendar.onSince: On. A calendar last read it {{when}}.
calendar.onNever: On. No calendar has read it yet.
calendar.private: Keep this link private: anyone with it can see your sessions and events. It is shown only now; you can get a new one at any time.
calendar.replaced: New link ready. The old one no longer works.

sync.title: Keep the list in sync
sync.intro: Read the college's Google Sheet or ERP export on a schedule, with the columns you mapped. A change to more than 5% of the rows waits for you to look at it first.
sync.offerBody: Read this source again on a schedule, with the same columns. Small changes apply by themselves; larger ones wait for you.
sync.never: Not run yet. The first run is after 2 am.
sync.queued: Sync started. It runs in the background.
sync.stopped: Syncing stopped. The imported records stay.
sync.pendingTitle: A change is waiting for you
sync.approved: Applying. Follow it in the import history below.

error.failed: We could not confirm that sign-in. Try again, or use your email or phone.
error.domain: Use your college account, not a personal one.
error.suspended: This account is suspended. Contact your college administrator.
error.unavailable: That way of signing in is not available right now.
error.expired: That sign-in took too long or was opened in another browser. Try again.

complete.title: Finish creating your account
complete.sub: You signed in as {{email}} with {{provider}}. A few details and you are in.
complete.expired: This sign-in has expired. Start again from the sign-in page.

admin.intro: Members can sign in with the college's own Google Workspace or Microsoft Entra ID accounts. Only addresses of the college's email domains can, and college verification still applies.
admin.noDomains: Add the college's email domains first, under Branding.
admin.mfa: Admins still enter their two-factor code after signing in.
admin.howGoogle: In Google Cloud Console, create an OAuth client of type Web application in the college's organisation, and add the redirect address below.
admin.howMicrosoft: In the Entra admin centre, register an app for accounts in this directory only, add a Web redirect address (below) and create a client secret.
admin.secretKept: Saved and hidden. Type a new one to replace it.

picker.title: Find your college
picker.intro: Type your college's address on CampusLink, as it appears on its posters and messages.
picker.label: College address
picker.hint: Only the first part, for example {{example}}
